name: 37-page-connectors
teaches: A page hands drt a connector family as a JavaScript object: under a config that grants it, what the object returns is the reply and what it throws is an error; under one that wires it without the grant, the gate denies it like any family.
cmd: echo '$ drt run --config app.json'; drt run --config app.json; echo; echo '$ drt run --config locked.json'; drt run --config locked.json
